title: A Dog's Perfect Christmas
plot_overview: At Christmas, a family in crisis struggles to keep its household together. A teenager, her grandfather, and his trusty basset hound face the challenge of holding the family together during the holiday, as they try to get through a difficult time at home.
will_you_like_this: You’ll like this if you enjoy holiday stories about family bonds and a loyal dog; Not for you if you prefer fast-paced plots or stories without family conflict.
review_summary: Pros: Christmas family focus; loyal dog companion | Cons: family crisis; limited plot details
